dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL with OO extensions (INVOKE, class/repository), htmlpp preprocessor, $set directives, free source format. Likely part of a Brazilian retail/ERP web application framework using HTML embedded in COBOL via EXEC HTML blocks.

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian retail ERP system - product assortment group (Grupo Desafio/Sortimento) management screen for a purchase suggestion algorithm (GVP - Algoritmo de Sugestão de Pedidos)
purpose.summary: This program renders a web-based UI screen (via embedded HTML) for managing product assortment groups related to a purchase suggestion algorithm. It loads combo box options from a file (WD06900 - Grupo Sortimento), validates a project flag (project 172), and handles form submission by delegating to a callback program. It is part of a larger Brazilian retail ERP web framework.

notable_features: EXEC HTML blocks (htmlpp preprocessor for web UI generation)
OO COBOL: REPOSITORY clause with CLASS definitions, INVOKE statement
COPY statements for modular copybooks (11 copies)
UTF-8 conversion via OO utility class
verdict.notes: The file uses a Brazilian Portuguese ERP web framework with an htmlpp preprocessor that embeds HTML inside COBOL EXEC HTML blocks. The program is part of a larger system (PH070058 series). Source format is declared as free via $set directive despite mechanical indicator showing fixed (the $set overrides). The EXEC HTML blocks contain extensive inline HTML/JavaScript which inflates line lengths beyond 72 characters. Domain is retail/commerce based on 'Produto Desafio' and sortiment group context.
